description: Flyer (#160): the largest text is the one word 'HELLO' over a slogan; a one-word title goes to review. Its body, the three-row list of topics and the tinted panel are read one column at a time (#281): the backdrop that bleeds off the page frames no table, so the paragraphs are not cells. The phone number is text.

contains_in_order: Health problems rarely happen when it’s convenient.
